Large 1536x1024 landscape or larger. Completely flat pure saturated chroma green #00ff00 background, no shadows onto green, no scenery, no text, no frame, no pedestal, no wires. FULL shoes and hands included. Each figure fills 80 percent of its cell height, separated on every side by green. Compelling detailed costume design, closed mouth restrained delighted expressions; preserve adult age. No pure chroma green on clothes. Crisp clean edges for exact chroma extraction.
